description.value: Patna Sweets & Restaurant is an Indian sweets shop and full-service restaurant offering authentic North Indian cuisine, from samosas made fresh daily and marinated Chicken Tikka to traditional sweets like Gulab jamun and Rasmalai. The menu spans vegetarian, non-vegetarian, tandoori, and Indian-Chinese fusion categories alongside daily specials and combo thalis. Catering services and a bookable event space are also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at patnasweets.com is fully accessible and consistently names the business 'Patna Sweets & Restaurant' (matching OSM alt_name, not OSM primary name 'Patna Sweets & Chat'). The website address is '2580 Cedar Park Place, Abbotsford, BC' — the OSM coordinates (49.049, -122.335) are geographically consistent with Abbotsford, not Chilliwack, making the OSM community tag suspect. Takeout is confirmed via 'Order Online' and DoorDash links; a dedicated Vegetarian menu section confirms plant-based options; no evidence exists anywhere for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging.
